places-oberranna-kleinkastell-kunzing-am.story: A 150 km round trip from Sankt Aegidi - roughly 2 h 35 in the saddle. It goes by way of Passau Haibach - Burgus, Künzing - Amphitheater und Vicus and back through Passau Haibach - Burgus. It crosses from Austria into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
